devices.name: MSP430FR2433
devices.notes: JTAG ID 0x98 then device ID 0x40 0x82 (TLV 0x1A04/0x1A05). Main FRAM 0xC400-0xFFFF (15 KB, the vectors and the two JTAG signature words at 0xFF80 included: an image that puts a value other than 0x0000/0xFFFF in both 0xFF80 and 0xFF82 locks the chip), information FRAM 0x1800-0x19FF (512 B). Not on hardware yet.
